_comment: High-impact US macro events that move the open. Times are US/Eastern on the RELEASE date. The guard blocks NEW ENTRIES around these; protective exits are never blocked. Update this file when the calendar is refreshed - it is read at every entry decision, so no restart is needed.

events.name: CPI (Oct)
events.note: m/m only (Oct-2025 shutdown gap). nowcast +0.24% headline / +0.21% core. Released 08:30 ET, one hour BEFORE the 09:30 open, so the reaction lands at the open - that is the trade this guard exists to prevent.

events.name: PPI (Oct)
events.note: Also feeds the Dec FOMC hike odds.

events.name: NFP (Nov)
events.note: First Friday of the month by convention - VERIFY against the official release calendar before relying on it.

events.name: FOMC decision
events.note: Mid-session release. Also sits inside the existing 14:00-16:00 kill zone, so this guard mainly adds the pre-release hour. Dec hike odds 76.8-78% after hot Oct NFP (+165k, 4.1% U).

events.name: Retail sales (Oct)
events.note: One hour BEFORE the open, so the reaction lands at the open - same shape as the CPI/PPI guard. Est +0.2%, prior +0.8%. Feeds the Dec FOMC hike odds.

events.name: Industrial production (Oct)
events.note: 15 minutes BEFORE the open. Released alongside import prices; the reaction lands in the first minutes of trading, so the open window stays blocked.

events.name: NAHB housing market index (Nov)
events.note: Released 30 minutes after the open - a mid-session release, so this one blocks around the print rather than the open.

events.name: Home Depot earnings (HD)
events.note: Reports BEFORE the open. Exact release time not independently verified - assume the worst case and keep the open blocked. EPS est 3.84, revenue est 42.81B.

events.name: Disney earnings (DIS)
events.note: Reports BEFORE the open. Exact release time not independently verified - assume the worst case and keep the open blocked. EPS est 1.68, revenue est 25.21B.

events.name: NVIDIA earnings (NVDA)
events.note: Reports AFTER the close, so the gap risk lands on the Wed Nov 18 open (the earnings guard already blocks NVDA into that open). This entry closes the last 10 minutes of the Nov 17 session. Consensus rev ~108.9-109.2B, EPS 2.47, guide 108B +/-2%.

events.name: FOMC minutes
events.note: Minutes of the latest FOMC meeting, mid-session release. Same guard shape as the FOMC decision entry: the pre-release hour is what this adds.

events.name: Anthropic IPO pricing (ANT)
events.note: IPO price is set AFTER the close on Wed Nov 18; ANT trades on Thu Nov 19 (Nasdaq). Price range 70-78, 825M shares, up to 64.4B + 26B Class N, ~6x oversubscribed. The real gap risk is the Thu Nov 19 debut, not the Wed session.

events.name: Retail sales (Oct)
events.note: Released 08:30 ET, one hour BEFORE the 09:30 open, so the reaction lands at the open. Consensus +0.2% (prior +0.8%) - a miss with the 10y at 5.13% is exactly what this guard exists for.

events.name: Industrial production (Sep) + import prices
events.note: 15 minutes before the open; the block carries into the first 30 minutes of the session.

events.name: NAHB housing market index (Nov)
events.note: Mid-session release, low impact.

events.name: Home Depot earnings (Q3)
events.note: Pre-open print (EPS est 3.84, revenue est 42.81B per the 08:43 morning-planning brief). VERIFY the exact release time before relying on it. Pre-open event: the guard blocks the first 30 minutes of the open.

events.name: Disney earnings (Q4)
events.note: Pre-open print (EPS est 1.68, revenue est 25.21B per the 08:43 morning-planning brief). VERIFY the exact release time - Disney normally reports after the close, so confirm before trading on it.

events.name: NVIDIA earnings (Q3)
events.note: AFTER the close. No new NVDA entries into the print; the reaction is tomorrow's open, see the Nov 18 reaction entry. Implied move ~+/-10% on options vs a realised +/-2.6% average.

events.name: NVIDIA earnings reaction (Nov 17 print)
events.note: Blocks the first 45 minutes of the Nov 18 open - the window where the Nov 17 after-close NVDA print gets priced. NVDA is on the bot's blacklist (ledger -$432), so this is a book-level hedge, not an NVDA trade.

events.name: FOMC minutes (Oct)
events.note: Mid-session release; the pre-release hour is blocked. The 14:00-16:00 ET kill zone already covers part of it.

events.name: Anthropic IPO pricing (ANT)
events.note: Anthropic prices its IPO Wed (range $70-78, ~825M shares, >6x oversubscribed per the 08:43 brief); ANT's first trade follows. Pre-open event: blocks the first 30 minutes of the open. VERIFY the pricing time.
